integrity: The exact annulus and both sharp thresholds are analytically proved; finite checker tests are supplementary. Self-review only; no independent audit or publication priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to antiunitary operators on complex dimension two. Relies on standard finite-dimensional Takagi factorization; no claimed higher-dimensional or general real-linear extension. The complete Jia–Liu 2025 text was inaccessible; an implicit older formula remains a priority risk.
title: Exact numerical annuli and dual transitions for two-dimensional antiunitaries
